title: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yi

translated_title: 多步归一：推理收缩与LLM智能体安全记忆复用的极限
translated_abstract: 思维模板、技能库、智能体记忆和缓存将许多推理步骤转化为一步，我们将这种现象称为“推理收缩”。收缩后的记忆能够节省推理步骤并避免错误，直到其底层事实发生变化，随后便会悄然给出错误答案。大多数系统通过统计成功与失败的次数来信任记忆。我们证明这类计数器是调校失当的变化检测器：对称计数器只有在经历其误报时间跨度的幂次之后才能察觉部分变化，而未截断的计数器可能永远无法察觉。在五个LLM回答基于被编辑事实的多跳问题的实验中，在相同信息条件下，ExpeL和ACE风格的计数器比经过认证的记忆多提供7.0-13.5倍的过时答案；而在带有精确验证器的代码任务上，这一比例达到35-73倍。安全性也是有代价的。当事实发生变化且每个记忆仅由其自身经过验证的结果来评判时，一个数字——“认证负载”——决定了任何安全记忆最多能跳过多少推理，并且在Zipf需求分布下，它产生……
tldr: 论文提出“推理收缩”概念，证明LLM智能体中基于成败计数的记忆更新机制是糟糕的变化检测器（比认证记忆多产生7-73倍的过时答案），并揭示了安全记忆复用存在由“认证负载”这一指标决定的理论上限。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "reasoning contraction," proves that success/failure counters in LLM agent memory systems are poorly tuned change detectors (serving 7-73x more stale answers than certified memories), and establishes a fundamental limit on safe memory reuse governed by a single "certification load" parameter.
